milestones.name: PSB Registration
milestones.description: Register at local Public Security Bureau within 30 days of arrival in Shenzhen.

milestones.name: Open Bank Account (ICBC)
milestones.description: Open RMB student account with passport, X-visa, PSB cert, and admission notice for Shenzhen University.

milestones.name: Activate UnionPay Debit Card
milestones.description: Activate UnionPay card for domestic payments and contactless POS in Shenzhen.

milestones.name: Tuition Payment (Shenzhen University)
milestones.description: Pay official tuition (CNY 28,000) via CNAPS direct to Shenzhen University official account. Payee must be verified.

milestones.name: Rent Deposit
milestones.description: Transfer rent deposit via UnionPay debit card directly to landlord/dormitory.

milestones.name: Setup Alipay / WeChat Pay
milestones.description: Link digital wallets to domestic account for campus dining and daily expenses in BDT equivalent.

milestones.name: Apply for Secured Credit Card
milestones.description: Apply after 3-month account history with steady inbound remittances. No approval guaranteed.

milestones.name: First PBOC Credit Reference Report
milestones.description: Request official PBOC credit report after 6 months of active UnionPay card usage.

priya@szu.edu.cn.name: Open Bank Account
priya@szu.edu.cn.description: Establish a Tier-1 debit account with ICBC, Bank of China, or CMB in Shenzhen.

priya@szu.edu.cn.name: Activate UnionPay Debit Card
priya@szu.edu.cn.description: Link your 62-prefix UnionPay chip card to mobile banking app and activate online CNAPS routing.

priya@szu.edu.cn.name: Setup Alipay & WeChat Pay Real-Name
priya@szu.edu.cn.description: Bind your passport identity and UnionPay debit card to WeChat Pay and Alipay digital wallets.

priya@szu.edu.cn.name: Apply for Secured Credit Card
priya@szu.edu.cn.description: Place a ¥3,000–¥5,000 security deposit with your host bank branch for a guaranteed student credit line.

priya@szu.edu.cn.name: Maintain Recurring Utility & Full Monthly Repayments
priya@szu.edu.cn.description: Charge recurring campus utilities and mobile bills to card; pay balance in full before due date.

priya@szu.edu.cn.name: Request PBOC Credit Reference Report
priya@szu.edu.cn.description: Inquire official PBOC Personal Credit Reference Report at PBOC branch or via commercial bank portal.
